info.title: Capacity Connect API
info.description: Capacity Connect REST API for Authentication, RBAC, Users, Dashboards and Training Management.

tags.name: Admin - User Management
tags.description: Administrative endpoints for user directory, search, filtering, approval, rejection, status management, and role assignment

get.summary: List, search, filter, and paginate users
get.description: Retrieve paginated user directory with search and multi-dimensional filters. Requires administrative role and user:read permission.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search query matching firstName, lastName, or email

parameters.name: department
parameters.description: Filter by department code, name, or UUID

get.summary: Get safe administrative user details by ID
get.description: Retrieve sanitized administrative user details by user UUID. Password hashes and authentication secrets are strictly excluded. Requires user:read permission.

404.description: User with specified ID not found

patch.description: Transitions user status to APPROVED, enabling login in the authentication lifecycle, and persists USER_APPROVED in audit trail. Requires user:approve permission.

404.description: User with specified ID not found

patch.description: Transitions user status to REJECTED, revokes active refresh tokens, and persists USER_REJECTED in audit trail. Requires user:reject permission.

404.description: User with specified ID not found

patch.description: Updates account status (PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, SUSPENDED, DEACTIVATED). Automatically terminates active sessions if account is suspended or deactivated. Logs corresponding audit event (ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED, etc.). Requires user:approve permission and ADMIN role.

400.description: Validation error or invalid status string

404.description: User with specified ID not found

patch.description: Assigns a new role (TRAINEE, TRAINER, ADMIN) to the user and revokes active refresh tokens to force immediate renewal of role and permission claims. Persists ROLE_CHANGED in audit trail. Requires user:role:update permission.
